what_it_does: Cloud data centers store data on solid-state drives (SSDs) that many customers share simultaneously. A 'noisy neighbor' problem arises: one customer's heavy workload can delay others. The obvious fix — giving each customer strictly separate storage resources — wastes capacity when customers are idle. FleetIO tackles this tension by using multi-agent reinforcement learning (a technique where multiple software agents each learn by trial and error in a shared environment) to manage storage dynamically. Each customer gets its own learning agent that controls scheduling and resource allocation; the agents observe the shared environment and adjust their behavior together so that no single tenant hogs resources, tail latency (the worst-case delays experienced by any request) stays low, and overall storage utilization stays high.
